response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_igg) AS avg_igg, AVG(avg_ana) AS avg_ana FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_igg AS `average aCL IgG`, avg_ana AS `average ANA`, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_averages) AS `ANA ratio` FROM sex_averages
